summary: Assess packaging damage, reuse, recyclability, and cold-chain logistics. Build practical agribusiness worksheets and action plans; explore the course.
lede: Sustainable packaging and logistics in agribusiness focuses on reducing product damage while planning packaging reuse and recovery. The intermediate course is for packaging, packhouse, postharvest, procurement, and logistics professionals who influence product handling and movement. Participants assess transit risks, compare packaging and transport trade-offs, design reusable or recyclable formats, review cold-chain controls, map batch and logistics-unit traceability, and evaluate reverse-flow measures.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who make or influence packaging, postharvest handling, transport, and recovery decisions for agricultural products.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agribusiness product handling, packaging, or logistics is recommended. No coding is required.
